BL-1411 — swarm_handoff.sh refuses a git_handoff whose acceptance feature file main has amended since the sender's merge-base: the contract the parcel was built against is checked at the send, so an in-flight amendment that never reached the holder (BL-1370, 2026-09-05) or reached it after the parcel left (BL-1353) is caught by the sender instead of by a downstream bounce
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-05 by the specifier from the closing-ceremony packet for
shift 2026-09-05 (BL-820 lean pass; outcome `process_ticket`, ref BL-1411).
Evidence: `backlog/evidence/closing-ceremony-2026-09-05-specifier.md`.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Minted from the 2026-09-05 closing-ceremony packet (BL-820 lean pass): its one spec-gap bounce, BL-1370, was caused by an amendment that never reached the parcel holder, and BL-1353 the same …
BL-1411 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1411" (or "reject BL-1411 <reason>") to act.
